# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5598

# Review — PAN-5598
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — new import cycle orders.ts ↔ orders-edit.ts fails CI lint, and `tests/unit/cli/orders.test.ts` fails on CI

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5598-review-cd972599
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5598/.pan/review/agent-pan-5598-review-cd972599/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5598 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5598
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5607
- Dispatch HEAD: cd972599c55d1fc168de9637ac344ae898285e41
- HEAD reviewed: b1f735d5b2ca69d42e4e1e3210d04715edb3a69e. This is the current PR head. The work agent pushed it during the review. It touches only `packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts`. All local checks below ran on this tree, and the CI evidence cited is from the run on this SHA (run 45114273460).
- Base: origin/main merge-base a8750cd1db1 (the local `main` ref is stale). No prior review cycle.

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] New circular import between `orders.ts` and `orders-edit.ts` fails `lint:circular` — `src/cli/commands/orders.ts:19`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: specification defect that the implementation followed; in_pr_scope (AC-9: `npm run lint` exits 0).
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `orders.ts:19` imports `registerOrdersEditCommands` from `./orders-edit.js`. `orders-edit.ts:15` imports `commandAction, commitOrders, formatBook, panDirFor, requireBook` (and the `OrdersCommandDeps` type) from `./orders.js`. PRD WI-7 steps 1–2 asked for exactly this, so the cycle comes from the spec.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected: lint passes. Observed: CI `lint-group (core)` on b1f735d (job 137493487514) fails with `✖ new circular dependencies found — these must be removed, not baselined` (`src/cli/commands/orders-edit.ts > src/cli/commands/orders.ts`). The aggregate `lint` check is also red. The local `npm run lint:circular` reports the same. Runtime is unaffected, because the bindings are used only inside functions. The blocker is the required CI gate.
- Evidence: the CI log above and a local reproduction.
- Fix: break the cycle without growing the baseline. Option A (preferred): move only the helpers `orders-edit.ts` needs (`commandAction`, `commitOrders`, `panDirFor`/`resolveOrdersProject`, `requireBook`, `formatBook`, the `OrdersCommandDeps` type) into a leaf module such as `src/cli/commands/orders-shared.ts`. Then `orders.ts` and `orders-edit.ts` both import from it, and `orders.ts` re-exports the helpers so existing imports and tests keep working. Constraint from the PRD "Working beside PAN-5597" section: do not move or touch `formatBookList`, the `queue` command, or the list formatting that PAN-5597 edits. Keep the `orders.ts` change to the helper definitions and the import lines. Option B: drop the import from `orders.ts`, let `orders-edit.ts` export a wrapper that calls `createOrdersCommand()` and registers the edit verbs, and point `src/cli/command-groups.ts:127` and the slash-command generator at the wrapper. Rerun `npm run generate:slash-commands` if the registration point moves. Spec correction: WI-7 should have named a leaf helper module.

### [requirements] `tests/unit/cli/orders.test.ts` "registers every documented verb and option in Commander help" fails — `tests/unit/cli/orders.test.ts:144`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope (AC-6: `npx vitest run tests/unit/cli/orders.test.ts` exits 0).
- Trigger and changed-code connection: WI-7 (524527c0ece) updated the expected verb list to end at `resume`. WI-8 and WI-9 then registered `item`, `preview`, `candidates` and `check`, but nobody updated this expectation.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected: the test passes. Observed: the `toEqual` diff shows `"item", "preview", "candidates", "check"` missing from the expectation. CI `test-shard (1/4)` on b1f735d (job 137493487252) is red with exactly this failure (`1 failed | 705 passed`).
- Evidence: the CI log above and a local `npx vitest run` (1 failed | 116 passed across 12 files; this test is the only failure).
- Fix: append `'item', 'preview', 'candidates', 'check'` to the expected list at `tests/unit/cli/orders.test.ts:144`, in registration order. Then rerun `npx vitest run tests/unit/cli/orders.test.ts tests/unit/cli/orders-edit.test.ts`.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] The MCP `project` argument description promises a default the route does not provide — `src/lib/mcp/tools-orders.ts:20`
- Severity: ~ SHOULD
- Classification: implementation defect (misleading contract text); in_pr_scope. The PRD gave no wording for this property.
- Trigger: `PROJECT_PROPERTY.description` says "default this conversation's project." The tools send no project when the argument is absent. The route then uses `resolveOrdersStateRoot` → `findProjectByPath(process.cwd())` of the **dashboard process** (`src/dashboard/server/routes/orders.ts:89`). PRD D8 states this explicitly. The live dashboard's cwd is `/home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck` (checked via `/proc/<pid>/cwd`).
- Impact: an agent in a non-Overdeck conversation (for example mind-your-now) that trusts the description and omits `project` reads Overdeck's books. `create_order_book` then creates an uncommitted book in Overdeck's primary checkout `.pan/orders/`. Write tools on an existing id from another project mostly answer 404.
- Fix: change the text to the true behavior, for example: "The registered project key. Omit it and the dashboard uses its own project, so pass it when you work in another project." Also note this in `configuration/mcp.mdx`. Fixing it in the same cycle as the blockers costs one line.

### [requirements] Composer-command manifest was stale at the dispatch head — RESOLVED at b1f735d
- At cd972599, CI `lint-group (core)` (run 45113843600) failed `lint:slash-commands` ("composer-command manifest has drifted"). Commit b1f735d regenerated it, and the local `npm run lint:slash-commands` now passes. No action needed beyond rerunning the generator if the cycle fix moves command registration.

### [test-coverage] `check` exit code and output are not tested through Commander — `tests/unit/cli/orders-edit.test.ts:233`
- Severity: ? MAY. The test named "check prints blocks and sets exit code 1" asserts only `runOrdersCheck`'s return value. The `BLOCK`/`WARN`/`No problems.` printing and `process.exitCode = 1` live in the Commander action (`src/cli/commands/orders-edit.ts:247-256`) and are not exercised. "check sends the project key it resolved" injects `projectKey`, so `resolveCheckProjectKey`'s cwd branch is not covered. Static reading shows the action is correct.

### [correctness] Minor helper inconsistency — `src/lib/mcp/tools-orders.ts:44`
- Severity: ? MAY. `optionalBoolean` and `optionalString` treat `null` as absent, but `optionalStringList` refuses `prereqs: null`. This is harmless but inconsistent.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger (merge-base a8750cd1db1 → b1f735d)
| File | Status |
| --- | --- |
| src/dashboard/server/route-scopes.ts | reviewed. Ten rows; `backlog-candidates` sits before `:id`; segment-count matcher (`pathMatches`) keeps `:id` from capturing deeper paths. All 10 routes in `makeOrdersRouteLayer` are covered. |
| src/dashboard/server/routes/orders.ts | reviewed. Only the `previewBrief` removal and the import. |

A scratchpad probe with bare Commander confirmed that the paired `--x`/`--no-x` options give `undefined` when absent and `false`/`true`/string when given, which is what the "only given fields" logic relies on. |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** two blockers (cycle, stale test assertion), one resolved finding (manifest), one SHOULD (project default text).
- **Security:** the new rows grant `read:state` reads and `operate` writes per D2/D3. `start_order_book` with `operate` matches `start_issue`. No auth helper changed. The PAN-5321 admin-only merge-train row is untouched. Book and issue ids are encoded and the route re-validates them. `briefFile` → `settings.briefOverlay` has no path check in the tool, but the route already accepted any string before this PR. In `src/`, `briefOverlay` is only stored by `src/lib/orders/writer.ts:73` and parsed by the route; no code reads a file from it, so there is no path-traversal exposure today. A future consumer should confine the path to the repo. No finding.
- **Performance:** CLI-only `listProjectsSync`/`findProjectByPath`. Nothing new and sync on server paths (NFR-1 met). Each tool is one async proxy call. No finding.
- **Requirements/UX:** see the AC matrix. Non-goals respected: no new routes or no-loss rows, no auth change, no unqueue/archive, queue/start unvalidated, no commit logic in routes, the route's laneAConcurrency check unchanged, no allowlist changes, PAN-5597 paragraphs untouched.

## Verification
- CI on b1f735d (run 45114273460): `lint-group (core)` FAIL (lint:circular), `lint` FAIL (aggregate), `test-shard (1/4)` FAIL (orders.test.ts). Passing: shards 2/4 and 3/4, `build (22)`, `lint-group (effect|skills|state)`, server smoke, integrations. Shard 4/4, test-e2e and the bare-host jobs were pending at review time, so they are unverified.
- CI on cd972599 (run 45113843600): `lint-group (core)` FAIL at `lint:slash-commands`, which b1f735d resolves.
- Local `npx vitest run` on 14 touched or PRD-named test files: only `orders.test.ts` registration test fails; the rest pass (116+22 tests).
- Local lints: `lint:circular` FAIL. PASS: `lint:slash-commands`, `lint:effect-diagnostics` (227 known, none new), `lint:docs`, `lint:skills`, `lint:last-verified`, `lint:effect-facades`, `lint:source-introspection`, `lint:file-size`, `lint:ratchet-audit`, `lint:quarantine-audit`, `lint:upstream-ports`, `lint:prompts`, and `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed `src/` files.
- Typecheck: reused the `overdeck/test` status for the PR head ("Verification gate passed (typecheck+lint; tests run on CI)"). That gate passed even though CI lint fails on `lint:circular`, so its lint coverage does not include the circular-dependency guard.
- The full test suite was not run (per review policy).

## Scope Note
The work agent's completion note says "All tests, typecheck, and lint checks passing", but CI lint and one CLI test fail on the PR head. The cycle comes from PRD WI-7's instructions. When a plan splits a command file into two, it should name a leaf module for the shared helpers.
